title: Traumatic brain injury and concussion in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the head injury (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/10/2026
Discharge Date: 05/24/2026
Reason for Admission: Motor vehicle accident (MVA) with head trauma.

Hospital Course:
Pt is a 56-year-old female admitted following a car crash. Initial presentation revealed a diffuse axonal injury. Pt was unconscious for three days post-impact before returning to her usual level of consciousness. During hospitalization, pt was monitored for neurological status. Imaging confirmed diffuse brain injury. Pt remained stable on neuro-checks. Physical exam showed RRR, CTAB, and WNL. Pt progressed well and was cleared for discharge.

Discharge Diagnoses:
1. Diffuse axonal injury
2. Traumatic brain injury

Discharge Medications:
1. Gabapentin 300mg BID
2. Meloxicam 15mg QD
3. Multivitamin daily

Follow-up:
F/u with neurology in 2 weeks. F/u with primary care in 1 week.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, MD
05/24/2026
explanations: Diffuse traumatic brain injury with loss of consciousness over 24 hours and return to the prior conscious level, initial encounter: S06.2X5A (HCC 397).

hccs.label: Major Head Injury with Loss of Consciousness > 1 Hour
